technology.summary: Today's technology news includes a discussion of the potential of local AI, as well as the challenges of voice AI. Apple's upcoming "Welcome Home" event is expected to feature smart home-related announcements, including refreshes to Apple TV and HomePod Mini, and a new smart home hub. In healthcare, Efferon has developed blood-purification technology to combat pediatric sepsis. Other news includes the unveiling of the full trailer for Blade Runner 2099 at NYCC, and a product that makes it easier to style and care for curly hair.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes the Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India joining forces to streamline regulatory procedures and attract foreign portfolio investors. Meanwhile, Indian equity benchmarks have declined due to profit booking and rising oil prices, and a resurgent El Niño pattern may exacerbate Southeast Asian bond selloffs. In the healthcare sector, hospital stocks slipped after the Supreme Court of India called for an investigation into steep cancer drug markups.

politics.summary:
The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court will list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, where protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Congress has claimed that tribal students headed for a protest in Mumbai were detained, and the party has condemned the action.

In other news, Donald Trump has cited a non-existent Indian election to call the US electoral process 'corrupt'. India's foreign exchange reserves have reportedly declined by USD 18.34 billion in a single week. Jairam Ramesh has attacked the CEC, claiming that his ability to execute illegal orders makes him a liability for the country. Finally, Bengali actor Koel Mallick has joined the BJP.
